# atom ctrl

> atom ctrl builds world thinking machines that learn how the world changes, predict outcomes, and help robots act across longer tasks.

## About

atom ctrl is a research lab. It builds systems that can understand an environment, predict what may happen next, and choose useful actions.

The work is focused on world models, action prediction, robot control, and longer-horizon tasks. The company is researching World Action Models, a class of predictive models for action and control.

The work is in progress. This site describes research directions, prototypes, and technical ideas. It does not claim that atom ctrl has a finished general-purpose robot or production model.

## Core ideas

- World models represent scenes, objects, state, and change.
- Action prediction estimates how an action could change an environment.
- JEPA helps models learn meaning instead of predicting every pixel.
- H-JEPA extends prediction across time and longer horizons.
- Robot control connects prediction with useful actions.

## Research

### Project Monarch

Project Monarch was an earlier atom ctrl model and research direction. It explored representation, memory, reasoning, and output. That work helped lead toward World Action Models.

Source: https://atomctrl.com/research/monarch

### Interaction Systems

This research explores real-time voice interaction. It covers streaming speech, partial understanding, turn state, and response formation while a conversation is still active.

Source: https://atomctrl.com/research/interaction-systems

### Gödel 1.6

Gödel 1.6 explores a hybrid local and cloud model architecture. Routine work stays local. More complex work can be routed to specialist systems when needed.

Source: https://atomctrl.com/research/godel-model

### Scaling Synthetic Data

This research explores whether cleaner structured data can give compact language models a better training signal.

Source: https://atomctrl.com/research/scaling-synthetic-data

## People

Aditya Prasad Panigrahi is the founder of atom ctrl. Anjali Panigrahi is an adviser and early supporter of the work.

Source: https://atomctrl.com/team
